_comment: Threshold configuration for ThresholdEvaluator. Phase 2 exit criteria: p95 <= 3000ms and error rate < 1%.
_boundary_rule: lte and lt comparators use <=; lt uses <. A metric EXACTLY equal to its threshold passes for lte/gte and fails for lt/gt.

thresholds.description: Recommendation p50 latency must be at or below 800ms
Recommendation p90 latency must be at or below 2000ms
Phase 2 exit criterion: recommendation p95 latency must be at or below 3000ms
Recommendation p99 latency must be at or below 5000ms
Phase 2 exit criterion: server error rate must be strictly below 1%
Overall p95 latency across all request types must be at or below 4000ms
Travel matrix cache hit ratio must be at or above 50% during hold phase

degradedThresholds.description: Degraded-provider p95 must still meet the 3s budget
In degraded-provider run, at least 90% of recommendation responses must carry travelEstimateDegraded=true
Error rate must remain below 1% even under degraded provider
